Subject: Submission of Audio Recording of earnings Conference Call 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am,  
 
Further to our letter dated April 30, 2026 intimating the schedule of Investor call at Thursday, 
07th May 2026, at 05:00 PM IST, we wish to inform you that the audio recording of the earnings 
conference call held today to discuss the Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) 
of the Company for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 is available on the website of the 
Company and can be accessed on the web link:- https://ceigall.com/regulation-46-of-sebi-lodr/  
 
The above information is also placed on the website of the Company www.ceigall.com  
 
Kindly take the same on your records.  
 
Thanking You,  
For Ceigall India Limited
